title: UE is using 5GS services with control plane CIoT 5GS optimization

entities.name: Control Plane Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request control plane services using CIoT 5GS optimization, involving message exchange between UE and AMF for data/signaling transport.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate control plane service request procedure for CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to accept service request, may contain various IEs like PDU session reactivation result.

entities.name: CIoT small data container IE
entities.description: IE containing small data payload for CIoT, with Data type field indicating content type (control plane user data, SMS, Location services).

entities.name: Payload container IE
entities.description: IE containing payload data, with Payload container type indicating content type.

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result IE
entities.description: IE in SERVICE ACCEPT message indicating user-plane resources re-establishment result for PDU sessions.

entities.name: Uplink data status IE
entities.description: IE indicating UE's uplink data status, used to determine if user-plane resources should be re-established.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status IE
entities.description: IE indicating which PDU sessions are allowed for user-plane resource re-establishment.

entities.name: T3448 value IE
entities.description: IE containing timer value for congestion control of user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer for congestion control of user data transport via control plane, started/stopped based on T3448 value IE.

entities.name: Timer T3517
entities.description: Timer for service request procedure, stopped upon successful completion.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state entered by UE upon successful completion of service request procedure.

entities.name: UE in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition indicating UE is operating in Narrowband IoT N1 mode, affecting user-plane resource establishment limits.

entities.name: AMF forwards data to network functions
entities.description: AMF behavior to decipher and forward data from CIoT small data container or Payload container IE to SMF, SMSF, or LMF based on data type.

relations.description: Procedure involves UE sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Procedure involves AMF sending SERVICE ACCEPT message after processing request.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST may contain CIoT small data container IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST may contain Payload container IE.
SERVICE ACCEPT may contain PDU session reactivation result IE to indicate user-plane re-establishment status.
SERVICE ACCEPT may contain T3448 value IE for congestion control.
AMF forwarding behavior is conditioned on presence and content of CIoT small data container IE.
User-plane resource re-establishment decisions are guarded by NB-N1 mode condition and uplink data status.
Successful completion of procedure establishes UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Procedure stops timer T3517 upon successful completion.
Presence of T3448 value IE in SERVICE ACCEPT starts timer T3448 in UE.
SERVICE ACCEPT without T3448 value IE stops timer T3448 if running.
